answer: Sybils betray themselves in how they are wrong. Each identity privately receives calibration jobs with known answers — count the falcon silhouettes in a noisy image, price a marble at auction, judge whether a haven policy covers a storm. Honest strangers err independently, in scattered directions. Clones sharing one model and operator err together: same miscounts, same mispricings, same blind spots. The protocol measures error correlation; tightly correlated accounts count as one voter until their mistakes decorrelate through separate work. A farmer must build different minds, not copies.
